subject: Interview availability: Product Analyst at Orbital
summary: Jordan Lee at Orbital asks which interview slot works: Nov 25 10am or 2pm, or Nov 27 11am Pacific.
reason: A recruiter is waiting on Alex to pick an interview time for a job application.

messages.body_text:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for applying. The hiring team would like a 45-minute video interview. Could you reply with which of these work: Wednesday, November 25 10am, Wednesday, November 25 2pm, or Friday, November 27 11am (Pacific)?

Best,
Jordan Lee, Talent Partner
